messages:
kai.r: Hey everyone, first day! Quick checklist: VPN, GitHub org, and test GPU access. Also need a tiny who-to-cc map for incident escalation for shadowing next week.

mira.devex: Welcome @kai.r! DM me your GitHub handle and manager. Ill send invites.

infra-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-9012 by kai.r (onboarding)  assigned to eng-infra.

owen.sre: For VPN + GPUs open an infra ticket with employee ID and intended duration. Escalation map (short): page oncall -> service owner -> platform/SRE -> EMs -> customer-ops.

tara.hr: Hi Kai, sending payroll + hardware form now. Orientation tomorrow 09:30 in #all-hands.

kai.r: Thanks! Who approves short Dedicated reservations (e.g., 3 GPUs for 3 hours)?

owen.sre: Eng-platform can approve ad-hoc short trials; include cost center and manager in the request. For anything recurring, route to finance.

mira.devex: I'll add you to the owners doc and DM a one-page who-to-cc cheat sheet.

kai.r: Awesome, thanks all :heart:
